model: The Battle Corps - Baker Street Irregulars

fluff.overview: The Battle Corps Legion maintains one of the most unconventional intelligence assets in the mercenary world: the Baker Street Irregulars. Named after the fictional street urchins employed by Sherlock Holmes, the Irregulars are composed of young battlefield refugees from across the Jihad who can pass for teenagers or even younger children. Armed only with auto-pistols and carrying surveillance and communications equipment, the Irregulars are not intended for direct combat. Instead, they specialize in urban infiltration, exploiting the simple fact that few people pay attention to children. Operating in civilian clothes through city streets and occupied zones, these scouts gather vital intelligence that the Battle Corps cannot obtain through conventional reconnaissance. The Irregulars performed several critical intelligence operations during Operation SCOUR, and the Battle Corps has often credited their survival to the information these unconventional scouts provided.
